newsitem.title: FRANCE: Generale des Eaux in French media shake-up.
newsitem.headline: Generale des Eaux in French media shake-up.

text.p: Generale des Eaux will sell its 19.3 percent stake in pay-television broadcast group Canal Plus to Havas for 5.6 billion francs ($1 billion) or 1,175 francs per share, according to a provisional version of a company statement obtained by Reuters.
Generale des Eaux will also sell its Generale d'Images unit to Havas for 526 million francs.

In return, Generale des Eaux will receive shares to increase its stake in Havas to 20 percent from 2.1 percent currently. On top of that, it will buy a 10 percent stake from Alcatel Alsthom to bring its total stake in Havas to 30 percent. ($ = 5.581 French Francs)
Generale des Eaux in French media =2
Generale des Eaux will also sell its 10 percent stake in CanalSatellite to Canal Plus or to a third party designated by the company.
The cable activities of Generale des Eaux will be sold in the course of the year to "a partnership chosen in concert with Havas and Canal Plus," the statement said.
A Generale des Eaux spokesman had no comment on the statement, provided by an industry source, and said a company board meeting was still going on.
